name: What preparation is needed before new flooring can be installed?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before new flooring can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a successful and lasting flooring installation. This typically involves removing old flooring, ensuring the subfloor is clean, level, and structurally sound, and making any necessary repairs. For some materials like hardwood, the subfloor might need specific moisture testing or acclimation time. Moving furniture and clearing the work area are also essential steps. We will outline all specific preparation requirements during our initial consultation to ensure a smooth process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes removing old flooring, ensuring the subfloor is clean, level, and sound, and making repairs. Furniture moving and clearing the area are also essential.
